ResearchProjectDef.label: kiiro paperfolding
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the art of paper. Paperfolding has a long history among the kiiro, they can create all kinds of things with just a piece of paper. It's amazing. \n\nAfter the study was completed, the ingenious kiiro would occasionally give elaborate paperfolding to friends in their social lives, which would promote friendship and good mood for both parties, as well as give the giver a bit of artistic experience.
